prompt.zh-TW: 下列哪些做法會讓綠丘單車行的存貨週轉率上升？
prompt.en: Which of these actions would raise Green Hill Cycles’ inventory turnover?

text.zh-TW: 減少冷門車款的庫存，只留暢銷款
text.en: Cut the stock of slow-selling models and keep only the popular ones

feedback.zh-TW: 正確。營業成本不變、存貨變少，分母縮小，週轉率上升。
feedback.en: Correct. With cost of sales unchanged and less inventory, the denominator shrinks and turnover rises.

text.zh-TW: 用同樣的庫存量賣出更多車
text.en: Sell more bikes while holding the same amount of stock

feedback.zh-TW: 正確。賣得多、營業成本變大，分子上升，週轉率上升。
feedback.en: Correct. More sales mean higher cost of sales, so the numerator rises and so does turnover.

text.zh-TW: 把客戶欠的款項收回來

feedback.zh-TW: 收款影響的是應收帳款與現金，存貨和營業成本都沒變，存貨週轉率不會動。
feedback.en: Collecting receivables affects receivables and cash; inventory and cost of sales are unchanged, so inventory turnover does not move.

text.zh-TW: 年底大量進貨，為春季旺季做準備
text.en: Stock up heavily at year end for the spring peak season

feedback.zh-TW: 年底進貨會讓期末存貨變大、分母變大，存貨週轉率反而下降；旺季前備貨可能合理，但指標會往下走。
feedback.en: Year-end purchases enlarge closing inventory and the denominator, so turnover falls; stocking up before the peak may be sensible, but the ratio will move down.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_08g66t9j}}＝營業成本 ÷ 存貨。{{option:o_a8z0}}縮小分母，{{option:o_ybcg}}放大分子，兩者都讓比率上升；{{option:o_kfb1}}與存貨無關，{{option:o_asx1}}放大分母、比率下降。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_08g66t9j}} = cost of sales ÷ inventory. {{option:o_a8z0}} shrinks the denominator and {{option:o_ybcg}} enlarges the numerator, so both raise the ratio; {{option:o_kfb1}} has nothing to do with inventory, and {{option:o_asx1}} enlarges the denominator and lowers the ratio.
